chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, protective jealousy (ghayrah) is part of faith.

key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith; inward belief and religious conviction
key_terms.الْغَيْرَةَ: protective jealousy; a sense of honor and moral protectiveness

ai.seo_question: How is protective jealousy (ghayrah) related to faith in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that ghayrah, meaning protective moral concern and guarding what is sacred, is rooted in iman. It presents this quality as an ethical expression of faith and a sign of moral responsibility.
